\chapter{Background}
Influence maximization asks for a seed set of bounded size that
maximizes expected spread in a diffusion model.
The objective is monotone submodular under the independent cascade
model, so a greedy seed selection achieves a $1 - 1/e$ approximation
when the budget is known exactly.

In practice the available budget is uncertain:
platform costs fluctuate, and the number of seeds that can actually
be activated is known only after commitments are made.
We study greedy selection when the budget is revealed online.
